result_text:
`all_files.zip` now packages the scope file lists under names derived from the configured aspect names, so renaming an aspect no longer breaks the export. I compiled the `reports` module, which succeeded. I didn't run any tests or the export itself, so the renamed-aspect case is unchecked at runtime.

The change is in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`, in the zip step. It replaces the five hard-coded `aspect_*.txt` literals with a lookup through `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`. That is the same helper that names the loose text files. The aspects go in the old order: main, test, generated, build and deployment, other.

With the default configuration the entries are unchanged. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry is `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. `git-history.zip` is written as well when a `git-history.txt` exists.
